The main endgame mode is name dtide. Dtide rotates stages and "rings" every two weeks with each rotation favoring a different realm. Is there any advantage to building any double-realm lineup that doesn't include Chaos?
Or should I keep it to either 1 pure realm or 2 realms including Chaos?
Double realm are good if you can make use of both realm gimmicks
For example,  ultra is a good mix in any team because you can use the ultra turn as an setup/safety turn (instead of the usual burst turn in pure ultra)
Similarly,  Caro furnace healing makes it a good mix option for any team that wants more survivability
You will see alot of realm mixing in late game, because certain premium supports are in that realm (e.g. clem horla thais)
Aequor is the only realm that doesn't get mixed as often
Since it wants to play with its own gimmick most of the time (Gmurphy full lemurian team for example)
